name: Broken tile mosaic
summary: A mosaic of shards of glazed tile and china set in mortar. A mason can cover a curved surface with it, and the pieces give free, bright colour.
how: Break glazed tile and china by hand into pieces of 2 to 10 cm.
Spread a bed of wet mortar, 2 to 3 cm thick, on the curved surface.
Press the shards into the bed with the glaze outward and keep a joint of 3 to 5 mm.
Wipe the face clean before the mortar sets.

origin.note: Antoni Gaudí and his team cover the benches and roofs of Park Güell with broken tile.

adoptions.via: Masons at Park Güell set shards of tile and plate on curved walls, benches and roof ridges.
